messages.subject: New website deployed
messages.body_plain:
As well as migrating the forums to Google Groups, today we have also upgraded our website.  It will have roughly the same content, but uses pkgdown <https://pkgdown.r-lib.org/> to make it easier for the documentation to stay up-to-date.

There are some things that need to be smoothed (eg, broken relative links), but does anyone have reactions in the meantime?

messages.subject: welcome
messages.body_plain:
Welcome.  We have a new location for the NLSY Kinship Links.  We've moved them to Google Groups, to better
facilitate access and use of the kinship links.

Thanks as always to Will Beasley for managing and updating the NLSY kinship links.

We hope that you'll post your successes and challenges, including questions, comments, confusions, and suggestions.
Look forward to seeing you on Google Groups!

Let us know if there's anything we can do to help!

Best regards,
Joe Rodgers, Vanderbilt University
